package.name: odom_calib
package.description: VESC odometry gain identification. Offline: analyze a rosbag2 (.mcap) against cartographer ground truth (run.py / analyze_bag.sh, no ROS needed). Online: a PASSIVE tuner node that estimates speed_to_erpm_gain and steering_angle_to_servo_gain/offset live while a human drives, streaming them to pitwall every ~1.5 s. Both share the same IRLS estimator.
